Baking: 15 minutes|servings=2|image=[[Image:CrispyGingerbreadCookies.jpg|300px]] }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]] This recipe makes '''crispy gingerbread cookies''' that are used for gingerbread people. To keep the cookies crisp, store them in an air-tight container. They can be decorated with [[Cookbook:Royal Icing|royal icing]]. ==Ingredients== *⅔ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (~160 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) packed light [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]] *⅔ cup (~160 g) [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]] *1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] *1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] *½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] *1 ½ teaspoon (½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]]) [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]] *⅔ cup (~160 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] *1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] *4 cups (1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]]/ 500g) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] ==Procedure== #Pour sugar, molasses, spices, and salt into large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. #Bring to [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]] and remove from heat. #Add the baking soda and butter and stir until butter melts. #Quickly stir in egg, and then add flour. Mix well. #Chill for several hours until firm enough to roll. #Preheat oven to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|325 °F]] (170 °C). #[[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] until thin on lightly-floured surface. #Cut with [[Cookbook:Cookie Cutter|cookie cutters]] and place on [[Cookbook:Cookie Sheet|cookie sheet]] sprayed with non-stick [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|cooking spray]]. #[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about 15 minutes at [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|325 °F]] (170 °C) and cool on racks. Cut with cookie cutters and place on cookie sheet sprayed with non-stick cooking spray.
